veranderings.voor: Sulke groepe staan bo en onder mekaar
veranderings.na: Sulke groepe staan hoër of laer as mekaar
veranderings.rede: 'Onder mekaar' usually means 'among themselves' in Afrikaans, so the ranking sense is ambiguous; 'hoër of laer as mekaar' says it plainly.

veranderings.voor: Iemand wat met eie hande dinge maak
veranderings.na: Iemand wat dinge met die hand maak
veranderings.rede: 'Dinge met die hand maak' is the natural idiom and word order; 'met eie hande' without a possessive reads elliptical.

veranderings.voor: het minder verskil as by Mapungubwe
veranderings.na: het minder van mekaar verskil as by Mapungubwe
veranderings.rede: 'Verskil' needs 'van mekaar' here so it is clear the houses and possessions differed from one another.

vlae.teks: Hulle het gekyk waar voorwerpe gelê het, maar nie alles is opgeskryf nie.
vlae.rede: The passive 'nie alles is opgeskryf nie' has no agent and follows a sentence about the people of Mapungubwe not writing; a learner may not know whether the archaeologists or the inhabitants failed to record things. Making it active ('hulle het nie alles opgeskryf nie') would fix it but requires confirming the intended agent.

vlae.teks: So kon hulle aflei dat ander soorte mense bo gewoon het.
vlae.rede: 'Ander soorte mense' is vague and slightly awkward for what the lesson means (people of a different, higher class); a sharper wording would need the writer to confirm the intended claim.
